items.title: The referral ask that does not make people wince
items.pt:
Most referral requests fail because they hand the recipient a blank sheet and a chore. When someone asks you to put in a good word, they usually want you to summarize their entire work history from scratch, which is work nobody wants to do on a Tuesday afternoon. 

Here is the one sentence you should send instead: "If you know anyone on that infrastructure team, would you mind dropping this two-line note into their Slack: [Your Name] is spinning up self-hosted engines and wants to talk about ope

items.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
items.pt: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retai

items.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
items.pt: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating

items.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
items.pt: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments.
